correctness.rationale: Uniform area on a spherical latitude zone gives height Z uniform on [a,b], mean m and second height moment q=m²+h²/3. For independent points X,Y, contraction of first, second and third coordinate moment tensors yields μ1=m², μ2=1/2−q+3q²/2, μ3=m²(20m⁴−60m²q+12m²+45q²−18q+3)/2. Since L²=2(1−X·Y), these equal the first three even chord moments by an invertible triangular map. μ2 determines q up to reflection q↔2/3−q; both distinct roots feasible iff 1/2<m<1/√3, and μ3 difference −4m²(5m²−1)(3q−1) is nonzero for two distinct feasible roots. Thus first three identify (m,h), with reflected axis the only isometry ambiguity. An exact pair m=11/20, h=√17/20 versus √57/20 has equal E[L²]=279/200 and E[L⁴]=583/200 but differing E[L⁶]=5523679/800000 and 5722119/800000. Independently recomputed these fractions and fold difference in SymPy.
